finding: Skilled staff shortages overtake costs as Slovak firms' top concern
bullets: Availability of skilled staff or experienced managers ranked as the most pressing problem among the seven tested for Slovak firms (n=239), scoring 6.64/10 — up 0.57 from 6.07 in the previous wave.
Costs of production or labour scored 6.62/10 (n=240), rising from 6.19 in the previous wave, remaining just below the EA average of 6.74/10.
Regulation scored 6.10/10 (n=236), easing marginally by 0.08 from the previous wave, yet remaining above the EA average of 5.87/10.
chart_subtitle: Skilled staff scores 6.64/10, topping Slovak firms' concerns.
